title: Context recovery truncation runtime event payload (D2-2)
description: D2-2 (2026-08-14, ADR-0010 v1.10 / CONTEXT_COMPACTION_DESIGN §6): a restored conversation exceeded the conservative recovery window (200K) before the first request — the controller mechanically dropped whole old tool rounds toward the recovery target, copied the full sidecar into the run journal as the audit copy, inserted a recovery marker, and journaled this event.

before_estimate_tokens.description: Estimated restored-conversation tokens (chars/2, conservative CJK-aware) before truncation.

target_tokens.description: Recovery truncation target — kept conversation estimates under this.

after_estimate_tokens.description: Estimated kept-conversation tokens after truncation (before the marker insert).

rounds_dropped.description: Complete tool rounds dropped (each round = one assistant declaration plus its tool replies and injected pushes).

messages_dropped.description: Messages removed from the seeded conversation.

messages_kept.description: Messages remaining after truncation plus the inserted recovery marker.

audit_path.description: Run-journal path of the full pre-truncation sidecar copy (audit evidence).
